metadata.title: Weekly Update: Learn, Contribute, Build
metadata.creator: Akshay Chavan
metadata.note: Humanitarians AI weekly progress update. Simple visuals only. Native 4K landscape; full native portrait version will be derived separately.

skin_warnings: B05: palette=claude but the outro is 'ClaudeVerdictArtifact' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

beats.role_note: Open the weekly update and establish the Learn - Contribute - Build progression.
beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Akshay, for Humanitarians AI. This week was about moving from learning the Brutalist video-production workflow, to contributing to the existing content pipeline, and finally building a technical explainer of my own.
beats.visual_intent: Simple opener. Show WEEKLY UPDATE and the three-part progression: LEARN, CONTRIBUTE, BUILD. Keep the frame clean.

props.command: Summarize this week's progress at Humanitarians AI.

beats.role_note: Explain learning the Brutalist production workflow.
beats.narration_text: I started by going through Professor Brown's Brutalist AI Video Production material to understand how Humanitarians AI videos are actually built - from scripting and narration to visuals, rendering, and quality control.
beats.visual_intent: Minimal process graphic. Four simple labels appear in sequence: SCRIPT, AUDIO, VISUALS, QC. No dense arrows or flowchart.

artifactLines: Build visuals around real audio timing
Render, inspect, and quality-check the final video

beats.role_note: Show the scale and type of Claude Bear content reviewed and uploaded.
beats.narration_text: I then worked through the Claude Bear video collection, reviewing and uploading fourteen videos covering topics such as Claude basics, flashcards, form generation, supplier selection, reorder policies, and workflow automation.
beats.visual_intent: Large 14 VIDEOS number with a small restrained grid of representative titles. Do not show all fourteen titles at once and do not use a complex diagram.

props.artifactHeading: 14 Claude Bear videos reviewed and uploaded

beats.role_note: Show that reviewed videos were organized into the appropriate Humanitarians AI playlists.
beats.narration_text: Those videos were published into the appropriate Humanitarians AI YouTube playlists, including Claude Basics and Extending Claude. This gave me hands-on experience with the existing content workflow while helping move completed material into the published library.
beats.visual_intent: Two simple playlist cards: CLAUDE BASICS and EXTENDING CLAUDE, with a few video cards moving into them. Maximum two destination boxes.

props.artifactHeading: Moving finished work into the HAI library

beats.role_note: Show the Kafka explainer as the week's build milestone.
beats.narration_text: I then applied what I'd learned by creating a Humanitarians AI technical explainer called How Kafka Handles Millions of Events. It explains Kafka's durable log, partitions, brokers, consumer groups, offsets, rebalancing, and replication. I produced the explainer through Brutalist in both landscape and portrait formats, with native 4K layouts for each orientation rather than simply cropping the landscape version.
beats.visual_intent: Show the Kafka explainer title, then two clean format cards: 16:9 4K and 9:16 4K. Kafka concepts appear as a short text list, not a network diagram.

props.artifactHeading: How Kafka Handles Millions of Events
artifactLines: Durable logs, partitions, brokers, and consumer groups

beats.role_note: Close on the week's progression and Humanitarians AI identity.
beats.narration_text: So this week's progression was simple: learn the production system, contribute to the existing pipeline, and then use that system to build something new. I'm Akshay Chavan, for Humanitarians AI.
beats.visual_intent: Clean three-word recap: LEARN. CONTRIBUTE. BUILD. Then branded Humanitarians AI sign-off.
